title: RFC 6962: Certificate Transparency (Experimental)
relevance: Defines append-only Merkle Tree logs, SCTs, STHs, inclusion and consistency proofs — the canonical model for public verifiable provenance.

title: RFC 9162: Certificate Transparency Version 2.0 (obsoletes 6962)
relevance: Successor to RFC 6962; adds algorithm agility and explicit STH frequency / gossip requirements for detecting split-view attacks.

title: Sigstore Rekor — Software Supply Chain Transparency Log
relevance: Production Rekor API and Trillian-backed Merkle log for attestations/signatures; closest analogue to a provenance hub without a blockchain.

title: RFC 9420: The Messaging Layer Security (MLS) Protocol
relevance: Only IETF standard for E2EE group messaging (TreeKEM, forward secrecy, post-compromise security); candidate wire protocol for SYM-2P confidential channels.

title: RFC 9901: Selective Disclosure for JSON Web Tokens (SD-JWT)
relevance: Final standard for hash-based selective disclosure of JWT claims; successor to draft-ietf-oauth-selective-disclosure-jwt.

topic: GitHub Pages limits / Static hosting constraints
title: GitHub Docs — What is GitHub Pages
relevance: Defines static-only hosting, Jekyll/Actions builds, no server-side code or database, 1 GB site/bandwidth limits — hard constraints on the provenance hub.

title: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0
relevance: Data model for credentials that SD-JWT VCs carry; anchors the selective disclosure + identity layer for SYM-2P.

title: W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) v1.0
relevance: did:web / did:key identifiers and DID Documents for self-sovereign agent identity on static Pages.

title: OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0
relevance: Federated identity and JWKS discovery via /.well-known/openid-configuration; underpins Fulcio-style ephemeral certs and OIDC-bound signatures.

title: CloudEvents v1.0
relevance: Standard envelope for SYM-2P events (specversion, type, source, id, time, data) with HTTP/Kafka bindings; transport-agnostic outer layer.

title: W3C ActivityPub Recommendation
relevance: Actor-model federation (outbox/inbox) — only W3C inter-software messaging standard with deployed federation; candidate if SYM-2P needs cross-org follow/subscribe.

title: Transparency.dev — Verifiable Data Structures / Trillian ecosystem
relevance: Generalizes CT's Merkle transparency to arbitrary verifiable logs/maps (Trillian); informs the A2 self-hosted log option.
note: Uses .dev TLD; verified via individual curl and GitHub cross-reference from S3.

title: Sigstore Docs — Rekor overview (rekor-monitor, API)
relevance: Documents Rekor REST API, inclusion/consistency proofs, and monitor automation — operational detail behind S3.
note: Uses .dev TLD; verified via docs site structure and GitHub repo cross-reference.
